import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface

OUT = "/Users/yuluo/Desktop/game/games_test/reverse-engineering/tiny-glade/evidence/toolchain/clutter/decomp/"
prog = currentProgram
ADDRS = {"0x140ee3fd0":"autoclutter_add_region","0x140ee48c0":"autoclutter_mark_dirty","0x140ee4bf0":"autoclutter_flush_candidates","0x140eecf00":"autoclutter_retain_regions","0x141247c90":"dirty_tiles_take","0x140960b20":"dirty_tiles_cell_from_world"}
meta = {}
for s, label in ADDRS.items():
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress(s)
    fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
    f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
    rec = {"addr": s, "label": label}
    if f is None:
        rec["error"] = "absent"
        meta[s] = rec
        continue
    rec["name"] = str(f.getName())
    rec["body"] = str(f.getBody())
    d = DecompInterface()
    try:
        d.openProgram(prog)
        res = d.decompileFunction(f, 60, monitor)
        if not res.decompileCompleted():
            rec["error"] = str(res.getErrorMessage())
        else:
            c = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
            open(OUT + label + ".c", "w").write(c)
            rec["c_len"] = len(c)
    finally:
        d.dispose()
    meta[s] = rec
open(OUT + "state_meta.json", "w").write(json.dumps(meta, indent=1))
print(json.dumps(meta))
